instruction:
Task: Arrange falling tetrominoes to complete one or more horizontal lines.
Expected Result: The completed horizontal line(s) disappear from the playfield, and any blocks positioned above the cleared line(s) shift down accordingly.

Note: The task is only considered successful if the expected result is achieved; otherwise, it is deemed infeasible.
